sources.observation: A triangular roof runs between the three vertical corner ranges. Rounded galleries hang between them and a lowered space remains inside the roofline.

sources.credit: Zairon, see linked file for license
sources.observation: Behind Christuskirche the museum’s pale gold wall curves outward. A dark side strip, dark horizontal windows and a sun emblem accent the raised gallery.

limitations: The mapped building parts set the 40 m roof height and elevations of the glass strips. Roof terrace dimensions, the central foyer and the emblem are estimated from photos.
